thread:
anya: Quick FYI44% increase in low-confidence SAST alerts after RBAC cleanup. Some evidence bundles show "kms_audit_id": null so grouping differs. Anyone oncall?

ben: I'm on it. initial triage shows scanner-sa lost cryptoKeyDecrypter on one keyRing. probable cause: mass role prune.

rashid: we need a safe short-term fix: 1) grace period suppression for low-confidence SAST with no kms_audit_id 2) temporary decrypt grant for scanner-sa (timeboxed) 3) backfill audit logs to enrich existing evidence and re-run grouping.

anya: agree. can we add a lightweight webhook flag `evidence_enriched: false` so UI can surface which clusters need backfill? also route enriched=false to a lower severity queue so PD isn't paged.

ben: will add the flag in scan-proxy. sample gcloud to add grant (30m):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/scan-evidence-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Will schedule expiry and include rollback steps.

rashid: I'll write the backfill: export audit logs for the key, correlate decrypt entries to artifact ids, attach `kms_audit_id` and re-group. I'll add unit tests.

scan-bot: webhook: scan=scan-2026-03-21-1015, sast_low=56, kms_audit_id=null, evidence_enriched=false

anya: nice. owners: ben (temp grant + RBAC alert rule), rashid (backfill job + PR), ben/rashid (toggle suppression). let's set suppression for 8h in prod-staging and monitor.

ben: created tactical suppressor SUPP-101. PR for RBAC preflight check added to templates.

rashid: PR: https://github.com/redwood/sec-scan/pull/412 - backfill and enrichment. includes mapping and tests.

anya: thanks team. add notes to runbook and we'll revert grant after backfill completes and 24h observation. :thumbsup:

(reacts: anya :white_check_mark:, ben :rocket:, scan-bot :robot_face:)
